issues.problem: C1 and C2 are not fully testable from title+abstract alone as they require understanding the specific method of storage or release, which may not be detailed in the abstract.
issues.suggestion: Rephrase C1 and C2 to focus on the presence of mechanisms or materials that suggest stable storage or efficient release, which can be inferred from title+abstract.

issues.problem: C6 is overly specific to Metal–Organic Frameworks (MOFs) and does not cover other advanced materials like metal hydrides, which are also significant in hydrogen storage.
issues.suggestion: Broaden C6 to include other advanced materials beyond MOFs, such as metal hydrides, to ensure comprehensive coverage of advanced material technologies.

issues.problem: E3 is not clearly distinct from the task criteria as it includes hydrogen separation technologies, which are sometimes integral to storage.
issues.suggestion: Clarify E3 to exclude only those separation technologies that do not contribute to storage efficiency or capacity.

issues.problem: The guidance does not clearly resolve the inclusion of technologies that involve hydrogen separation as part of the storage process.
issues.suggestion: Add specific examples or criteria to determine when separation technologies are integral to storage and thus included.
